name: Peroxide [Update!]
desc:
Peroxide is an anime stylized fighting game in which players fight monsters to get stronger, as well as partake in hard trials to gain new abilities.

Q to dash
E to take out your weapon
G to use a mode
N to teleport to your spirit realm/skill bind menu
V to carry NPCs, players or objects
B to grip NPCs or players
F to block
F + M2 while getting hit to pushcounter

Premium Benefits within the AFK world to gain double passive product essence.
